summary: Complete rebuild implementation plan for YKP Supplies (ykp-eg.com) as a premier international B2B manufacturer website. Encompasses 17 specialized B2B pages (Home, Products, Manufacturing, Factory, Custom & Private Label, Wholesale, Distributor, Museum/Tourist Gifts, Corporate Gifts, About, Quality, Shipping, Blog with 12 SEO articles, FAQ, Contact, and Request a Quote), bilingual English/Arabic architecture, B2B lead capture engine with email and WhatsApp integration, and rich Schema.org structured data.
